Graph-based approach to impute missing precursors. This approach assumes that the ratio of any two precursors from a given protein solely relies on physico-chemical properties and digestion and therefore is equal in all samples/runs. Creates for every protein group a directed, weighted graph with precursors as nodes and median ratio of any two precursors (nodes) over all samples/fraction as edge weights between nodes. These ratios are then multiplied with present precursors over samples, median over them is used as intensity of missing precursor.  This approach may not impute all missing precursors, as advantage it uses global information over all samples about precursor ratios, but imputes missing values only from precursor intensities within a sample times global ratios.
